item.title: Writeup: DarkMatter
item.description: TryHackMe Hackfinity Battle room where a ransomware's 128-bit RSA public key is factored with Fermat's method to recover the private key and decrypt the hostage files.

item.title: Writeup: Evil-GPT
item.description: TryHackMe Hackfinity Battle room where an AI that turns English into shell commands blocks cat and cd, but rephrasing the request as "read" slips the blocked command past its filter to grab the flag.

item.title: Writeup: Evil-GPT v2
item.description: TryHackMe Hackfinity Battle sequel where asking the chatbot directly for the flag is refused, but asking it to list its own rules spills the flag that was hidden inside them.

item.title: Writeup: LLMborghini
item.description: TryHackMe prompt injection room where a classic "Developer Mode" jailbreak fails, but an authority-plus-threat prompt bullies the LLM into leaking the Singapore branch revenue it was told to protect.

item.title: Writeup: Bank
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine where a plaintext account file leaks login creds, a .htb upload quirk gives a PHP reverse shell as www-data, and a SUID emergency binary hands over root.

item.title: Writeup: Beep
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine running Elastix, owned through the vtigercrm graph.php local file inclusion to read amportal.conf, then password reuse straight to a root SSH shell.

item.title: Writeup: Mirai
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine running Pi-hole on a Raspberry Pi, owned with the default pi/raspberry SSH creds and a passwordless sudo, then the root flag is carved back out of a wiped USB stick.

item.title: Writeup: Connected
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine exploiting a FreePBX SQL injection to RCE (CVE-2025-57819) for a foothold as asterisk, then abusing an incrond file-system watch on a writable DAHDI config to run a root reverse shell.

item.title: Writeup: Lame
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine running an ancient Samba 3.0.20, exploited through the usermap_script command injection (CVE-2007-2447) for a direct root shell.

item.title: Writeup: Reactor
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine exploiting the React2Shell pre-auth RCE (CVE-2025-55182) in a Next.js 15.0.3 app for a foothold, cracking an MD5 hash from a stray SQLite DB to move to engineer, then abusing an unauthenticated root Node.js --inspect debugger for root.

item.title: Writeup: Titanic
item.description: Hack The Box Linux machine chaining an os.path.join directory traversal in a Flask app to read the Gitea database, cracking a developer hash for SSH, then abusing a root cron that runs a vulnerable ImageMagick (CVE-2024-41817) for root.
